title: macOS needs its grid back
summary: A blog post arguing that macOS should reintroduce a grid-based window and app layout system to improve productivity, referencing similar features in older macOS versions or competing operating systems that offer structured window management.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of structured grid-based window/app tiling in modern macOS that existed in earlier versions.
why_valuable: Provides UX perspective on how grid-based interfaces can significantly improve desktop productivity and window organization for power users.
